questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: A bus is ____ than a bicycle.
questions.explanation: Big is short and ends in one vowel and one consonant, so the g doubles: bigger. Short adjectives take -er, not more.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: Lake Kivu is ____ than Lake Muhazi.
questions.explanation: To compare two things, add -er: deeper than. Deepest is for comparing one with all the others.

questions.prompt: Which word comes after a comparative when we compare two things?
questions.explanation: We say taller than, bigger than. Then is a time word and that is a pointing word.
Heavy ends in a consonant and y, so y changes to -ier: heavier.

options: My brother is tall than me.
My brother is more taller than me.
My brother is taller than me.
questions.explanation: Taller already means more tall, so we do not add more. And tall alone cannot compare.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: The market is ____ than the bridge.
questions.explanation: Wide already ends in e, so add only -r: wider.
